violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MASHED PURPLE POTATOES AT 48F, MILK AT 48F, CHICKEN WINGS AT 49F, COOKED POTATOES AT 48F, SHREDDED CHEESE AT 50F, MASHED POTATOES AT 48F, MOZZARELLA AT 49F, SLICED CHEESE AT 49F, NOODLES AT 49F, AND HALF AND HALF AT 50F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS WALK-IN COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED WALK-IN COOLER AAT 48F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OF ALL TCS FOODS OUT OF TEMPERATURE DURING INSPECTION. BUILDING ENGINEER CAME DURING INSPECTION TO START TO FIX COOLER. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH PROOF THE COOLER IS MAINTAINING PROPER TEMPERATURE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINKS THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 76F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC CONTACTED BUILDING ENGINEER DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD MEET 100F AT A MINIMUM BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED VARIOUS HANDWASHING SINKS MISSING SIGNAGE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC POSTED SOME SIGNAGE DURING INSPECTION AND EHS WILL EMAIL PIC MORE COPIES OF SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CUT HONEYDEW AT 46F IN THE ROLL-IN COOLER #1, PICKLED RED ONION AND CUT PICKLED ONION AT 47F IN THE 2-DOOR UPR CONTINENTAL COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOOD TO ANOTHER COOLER TO COOL DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 76F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC UNDERSTANDS THREE-VAT SINK SHOULD MEET 110F AT A MINIMUM BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.
